description: Every way a person creates something on the two diagram canvases, and the path each takes: 'at-once' creates it with defaults and edits it in the Selection card; 'dialog' opens a form first and needs a stated reason. backend/tests/test_canvas_creations.py checks each handler exists and that each editor page renders no create/edit dialog that is not listed under 'dialogs', so a new creation cannot skip the decision.

creations.reason: Choosing which existing elements to draw is a selection among records, not a creation; there is nothing to default.
A view switch is configuration of the diagram (a rule and members), not a shape drawn on the canvas, and its rule has no sensible default.

DiagramFormModal.reason: Edits the diagram's own fields from its header.

ConnectionFormModal.reason: Edits one connection of a line that stands for several; also the creation fallback when the project has no connection type (a connection cannot exist without one), where it links to the setup.

ConfirmDialog.reason: Confirms leaving the diagram with unsaved changes.

ToggleFormModal.reason: Configures a view switch (see the view switch entry).

StateMachineFormModal.reason: Edits the diagram's own fields from its header.

StateFormModal.reason: The double-click edit dialog of a state.

TransitionFormModal.reason: The double-click edit dialog of a transition.

ConfirmDialog.reason: Confirms a delete or leaving with unsaved changes.
